name: vending
description: Dispenser furniture: `vend` pulls a data-driven item (flags.vends) from a machine in the room, drops it in your bag, and coughs a line to the room. Free institutional food and the like; reusable for any dispenser.

vend.note: KNOWN GAP: furniture flag-value gate (flags.vends carries the item id). Flag values aren't tag-anchored, so availableActions can't surface it — the machine's description cues the VEND button. Same class as synthesis:cook.
